en.headline: School nomination scheme for university places opens today
en.dek: The Education Bureau scheme runs until 2 December. Each local secondary school may nominate two students for one of more than 300 funded programmes.
body: Nominations opened on Wednesday for the sixth School Nominations Direct Admission Scheme, and will close on 2 December, the Education Bureau said.

The scheme is for local Secondary 6 students who will sit the 2027 Diploma of Secondary Education Examination and plan to start an undergraduate degree in September 2027. It is aimed at students with exceptional talent in a particular field that the diploma examination may not fully assess.

Each local secondary school may nominate up to two students. Each nominee may apply to one of more than 300 designated undergraduate programmes funded by the University Grants Committee. The eight participating universities have set admission criteria for individual programmes that are not based on diploma results.

The bureau said the universities will interview all nominated students and issue direct-admission offers to successful candidates before the 2027 diploma results are released. Nominees must also apply through the Joint University Programmes Admissions System.

zh.headline: 學校推薦直接錄取計劃今起接受提名
zh.dek: 教育局第六屆計劃提名期至12月2日。每間本地中學可推薦最多兩名中六生，報讀逾300個教資會資助課程之一。
body: 教育局宣布，第六屆學校推薦直接錄取計劃周三起接受提名，提名期至12月2日結束。
計劃供將應考2027年香港中學文憑考試、並計劃同年9月升讀學士學位的本地中六學生參加，對象是在特定範疇具過人才能、而有關才能未必能透過文憑試全面評核的學生。
每間本地中學最多可推薦兩名學生。每名獲推薦學生可報讀一個指定的大學教育資助委員會資助學士學位課程，今屆有逾300個課程參與。八所參與的教資會資助大學已為個別課程訂下不以文憑試成績為基礎的收生準則。
教育局表示，大學會為所有獲推薦學生安排面試，並於2027年文憑試成績公布前向成功申請者發出直接錄取通知。獲推薦學生亦須同時經大學聯合招生辦法申請。
